resources.string: DiPlay settings, drag to move
Tap Settings at the edge of the screen. Drag the button if it covers a control.
Closing the previous connection… The next connection will start after cleanup finishes.
Head unit Bluetooth address (optional)

Normally no entry is needed. If the system cannot provide its address, you may supply the car’s Bluetooth address here. Automatic system readings take priority. Leave blank and save to use automatic configuration. Do not enter the iPhone or Wi-Fi address.
Enter six pairs of hexadecimal digits separated by colons. Placeholder and iPhone addresses cannot be used.
Open system information
Connect your iPhone
Keep iPhone Bluetooth and Wi-Fi on. Accept CarPlay on your iPhone when prompted.
iPhone: %1$s
Your iPhone will be selected when you connect.
First connection · Add hotspot details
Tap below to start CarPlay
Car hotspot: %1$s
First connection: save the car hotspot name and password.
Wi-Fi and Bluetooth being connected does not start CarPlay. Tap Connect iPhone below.
Connect iPhone
View connection progress
Change iPhone
Hotspot settings
Turn on the car hotspot, preferably at 5 GHz. Save the same name and password here once. Your iPhone uses the car hotspot; leave its Personal Hotspot off.
Save hotspot details and connect
Pair your iPhone in the car Bluetooth settings once. DiPlay remembers your selection.
Android 9 normally creates a 2.4 GHz app hotspot. DiPlay’s automatic hotspot requires 5 GHz, so this version uses the car hotspot.
Preparing the connection
Loading the local accessory identity. iPhone authentication has not completed yet.
1 / 3 · Checking the car hotspot
Keep the car hotspot on. Checking its network interface.
2 / 3 · Finding your paired iPhone
Unlock your iPhone and keep Bluetooth on. A music Bluetooth connection alone does not establish CarPlay.
2 / 3 · Connecting to iPhone Bluetooth
3 / 3 · Negotiating CarPlay
Check your iPhone for an “Allow CarPlay” prompt. Waiting for the phone to finish setup.
Waiting for the CarPlay picture
The hotspot is ready. Starting the CarPlay receiver.
Waiting for the USB connection
USB connection help

Use a USB data port and cable. Unlock your iPhone and accept Trust / CarPlay. Connecting temporarily switches the phone’s USB audio/control function. Reconnect the cable if the original function does not return after exit.
USB device access was not allowed
Tap Retry and allow DiPlay to access the USB device when the car asks. Reconnect the cable if the prompt does not appear.
Your iPhone has not started CarPlay
Unlock your iPhone and check for CarPlay prompts. If nothing appears, retry or check the saved hotspot details. You can also test with USB.
Car hotspot could not be used
Check that the car hotspot is on and its saved name and password match. If it is on, save a diagnostic report so we can check this head unit’s network interface.
Connection permission is needed
Allow Location for DiPlay on Android 9 (Nearby devices on newer Android), then tap Retry.
CarPlay authentication could not complete
The experimental identity may be incompatible with this iOS version. Check the failure details and save a diagnostic report.
The CarPlay Bluetooth channel could not connect
Check the selected iPhone and its pairing. If the car Bluetooth is on but unavailable here, the head unit may not expose it to ordinary apps.
Connection interrupted
Retry
Cancel and return
Failure details
Connecting for %1$d seconds
No picture yet. Check your iPhone, retry, or open hotspot settings.
Retrying automatically…
Check connection settings
Waiting for iPhone to identify the car
The Bluetooth or USB channel is open. Waiting for the iPhone identification response; authentication has not started.
Authenticating CarPlay
Exchanging the accessory certificate and challenge response with iPhone. This does not yet mean authentication succeeded.
Authenticated · waiting for iPhone to enable CarPlay
USB access was granted, but the phone could not switch to CarPlay mode. Automatic retries are paused. Export the connection log; it includes the configuration and driver result.
Hotspot details sent · waiting for iPhone
Keep the car hotspot on. Check that its name and password match the saved settings.
Start requested · waiting for CarPlay
Connection timed out at this stage. Automatic retries have stopped. Unlock iPhone, check its prompts, then tap Retry. Save a diagnostic report if this repeats.
Allow DiPlay to access the USB device in the dialog on the car screen.
Switching iPhone to CarPlay USB mode
Establishing the USB data channel
Keep the data cable connected and iPhone unlocked. The screen will update when the phone responds.
Waiting for iPhone trust authorization
Unlock iPhone, tap Trust if prompted, and enter its passcode. If you previously denied trust, reconnect the cable and retry.
Starting the iPhone CarPlay service
Preparing the USB network
iPhone did not enter CarPlay USB mode
Export USB + wireless logs
Try wireless and USB once each, then export one file. Both histories are kept. Share or copy the report before uninstalling.
